messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert — otel collector export to Honeycomb returning errors (100% failure) for the last 3m. Auto-retries exhausted. Link: https://status.honeycomb.io/incidents/abc123 :rotating_light:
ryan_oncall: seeing it too, traces stopped showing up on the dashboards. spikes in export errors in otel-collector logs.
priya: on it, will pull logs and start mitigation. tagging infra-bot for backup exporter check. @infra-bot can we flip to buffered-s3 exporter?
infra-bot: Confirmed: honeycomb intake 502/503 and 429 spikes. No automatic fallback configured for otel-collector. Buffered S3 exporter available in config but not enabled by default.
alex_devex: fyi product teams will ask — which customers impacted? looks like Dedicated+Hosted customers with tracing enabled.
sara_sre: quick assessment: internal dashboards (traces) are delayed/missing. Metrics and logs unaffected. No evidence of data loss from app side — only export path.
priya: commands I'll run now: ```kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/otel-collector && kubectl -n infra apply -f /manifests/otel-buffered-s3-patch.yaml``` patch will enable buffered-s3 exporter and short-circuit honeycomb endpoint to go to S3.
ryan_oncall: if we enable buffered-s3, we'll resume capture and avoid missing spans; product will see gap until we replay. good plan.
priya: applying patch now...
infra-bot: patch applied, otel-collector rolling restart started (pods 1/3 -> 3/3 up).
priya: otel-collector logs after restart: ```ts=2026-03-15T12:11:02Z level=error exporter=honeycomb error=\"http request failed: 502 Bad Gateway\"``` and ```exporter=s3 buffered=true status=ok started-uploader```.
alex_devex: can we add a small note for customers that trace ingestion is delayed and we'll replay once honeycomb is back? I'll draft a short blurb.
emi_product: please include estimated window and that logs/metrics are unaffected. customers will want reassurance.
sara_sre: monitoring: set a temporary alert on otel-collector backlog size > 50k and exporter-error-rate > 20% so we know when to scale.
ryan_oncall: handing off — I need to go to another page. Priya taking primary; Sara you continue ops monitoring. Priya pls post handover summary. @emi_product please prep customer-facing line.
priya: handover ack. Current mitigations: buffered-s3 exporter enabled, rollouts healthy, collector now queueing and uploading to s3. Honeycomb status shows degraded ingest. No production rollback required. Next steps: 1) monitor backlog growth and uploader success 2) prepare replay plan for S3 -> honeycomb once vendor clears 3) ETA to customers: initial note within 30m.
alex_devex: draft for status page/customer note: "We're seeing degraded traces ingestion due to a third-party vendor outage affecting trace exports. Traces may be delayed or missing; logs and metrics are unaffected. We're buffering spans and will replay to restore traces when vendor resolves."
emi_product: LGTM, add link to incident channel and contact for high-severity customers.
priya: replay plan (short): once honeycomb declares recovered, we will: - validate honeycomb intake healthy - run replay job to stream from s3 buffer to honeycomb using otel-replay tool (can throttle to avoid causing another rate limit) - monitor error rate and dashboard backfill progress.
ryan_oncall: flagged potential risk: if honeycomb enforces stricter dedupe, some spans may double if replay overlaps; we'll coordinate IDs.
sara_sre: mitigation note: set exporter max-retries to 5 and enable exponential backoff during replay window.
priya: I'm leaving a runbook note in the incident tracker and will follow up in the morning. Handing to Sara for overnight monitoring.
sara_sre: taking over monitoring. will escalate to infra on-call if backlog > 200k or uploader errors > 10%.
ryan_oncall: thanks team. closing my page.
incident-bot: Incident thread created: otel export gaps -> vendor intake issue. Incident severity: sev-2 (traces only). Created ticket: INC-2026-314.
priya: final note for handoff: replay will likely take several hours depending on backlog size; recommend product comms mention potential partial backfill and follow-up when replay completes.
emi_product: drafting customer email now. will post sample in #customer-commms for review.
ryan_oncall: all good. if anything urgent ping me directly. :thumbsup:
